name: Standard AI-Guided Issue Resolution Playbook
description: Canonical V7 governance playbook for disciplined issue resolution with COSO assertions and mandatory RCA.

workflow_steps.guidance: Determine if this is a Risk (Possibility) or Issue (Materialized). Use severity triage: L=Optional, M=COSO Required, H=COSO+RCA Required, C=COSO+RCA+Decision Required.
Isolate the problem. Stop the spread. Containment is NOT closure.
Establish the bridge between 'what could happen' and 'what is happening'. Trace to MATURED_FROM -> Risk.
Mandatory for Medium+. Define the control breakdown using the restricted list of 17 principles.
Hard Gate. Determine WHY it happened. Distinguish root cause from symptoms. No closure without RCA.
Select strategy class: Corrective, Preventive, or Compensating. Assign owners and due dates.
Formal review of resolution against ISO/IEC 23894 and NIST AI RMF.
48h without RCA triggers auto-escalation and closure block. LOG ALL EVENTS.
Prepare the analytical case for the chosen fix.
Mandatory for high/critical. Re-establish human accountability for the control restoration.
No de-escalation without evidence of control restoration. Verify containment and corrective action.
Final closure. Update Risk Register. Prevent recurrence.

governance_rules: Rule 1: No Medium+ closure without RCA.
Rule 2: No Medium+ closure without COSO mapping.
Rule 3: No high/critical resolution path adoption without DECIDED_BY.
Rule 5: 48h open without RCA = Mandatory Escalation + Closure Block.
Rule 6: No de-escalation without evidence of control restoration.
